subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement readiness & MPA next steps (AcmeCloud)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acmecloud.com>; Ben Carter <ben.carter@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Procurement readiness & MPA next steps (AcmeCloud)

Hi Alice / Ben —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the procurement path and timeline. Notes below are intentionally concise — happy to jump on a short follow-up if helpful.

Call recap:
- Use case: LLM-powered search & summarization for internal support articles (prod traffic ~5k requests/day).
- Primary constraint: security & audit logs for regulated data; also need predictable monthly billing.
- Preference: PO via procurement (preferred) but open to card for POC. Marketplace listing would be ideal for procurement team but not a blocker.

Proposed commercial path & timeline (high-level):
1) Legal review (SOW/Order Form) — 1–2 weeks
2) Security review (SSO, audit logs, SOC 2 evidence) — 1–3 weeks (can run in parallel with legal)
3) Finance review & PO issuance — 1 week after approvals
4) Provisioning / onboarding — 3 business days after PO/contract signed

Immediate next steps:
- I will share an updated Mutual Action Plan (attached) mapping owners and milestones.
- Can you confirm: (a) procurement contact for PO, (b) whether the marketplace option is required, (c) any internal deadlines (e.g., Q3 budget cutoffs)?

Attachments: Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan_v2.xlsx (MPA), Redwood_SaaS_Order_Form_v1.pdf (order form draft).

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182
From: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@acmecloud.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@acmecloud.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement readiness & MPA next steps (AcmeCloud)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers:
- Procurement contact for PO will be Marta Ruiz (cc'd) — she owns vendor onboarding and PO issuance.
- Marketplace: Finance prefers marketplace for recurring SaaS purchases, but procurement/legal can approve vendor off-marketplace if there's an approved contract. Marketplace would speed PO issuance but isn't a hard requirement.
- Internal deadlines: we need contract signed by end of July to hit the August model rollout.

Marta, can you confirm typical lead times for legal/security and PO? Also tagging Ben (security) for the SOC 2 evidence cadence.

Best,
Alice
Product Ops, AcmeCloud
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: Procurement readiness & MPA next steps (AcmeCloud)

Folks —

Forwarding AcmeCloud's responses. Key asks: they prefer PO (Marta) and marketplace would help but not required. Contract target: signed by end of July. Can we fast-track a redline-friendly order form + SOW to keep legal within 2 weeks? Also Marcus, Ben (security contact) asked about SOC 2 cadence — can we prepare the SOC 2 summary + SOC report access steps for Ben?

I'll follow up with a calendar invite for a short 30-min MPA check-in next week.

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acmecloud.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@acmecloud.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan + proposed milestone dates (AcmeCloud)

Hi Alice / Marta / Ben —

Attached is the updated Mutual Action Plan (Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan_v2.xlsx) and a draft order form (Redwood_SaaS_Order_Form_v1.pdf). Below are the actionable milestones I propose to meet your end-of-July signing target. Please flag anything that won't work.

Proposed milestones (owner / target date):
- 2026-06-30: Redwood sends redline-friendly order form & MPA owner assignments (Marissa) — DONE (attached)
- 2026-07-07: AcmeCloud legal to provide comments on order form (Marta / legal)
- 2026-07-09: Security review complete (Ben) — Ben requested SOC 2 summary and evidence access; Redwood to grant read-only link to SOC report and runbook by 2026-06-30 (Rachel)
- 2026-07-14: Final contract sign-off (legal/finance)
- 2026-07-16: PO issued (if on PO path) / marketplace purchase completed
- 2026-07-19: Provisioning and onboarding kickoff

Notes on parallel workstreams:
- Legal and security can run in parallel. We can provide a Docusign-ready order form for faster signatures once redlines are agreed.
- If AcmeCloud prefers to start a card-based POC immediately, we can enable a 30-day POC on card while legal/PO run in parallel.

Action items for AcmeCloud:
- Confirm procurement/legal owner who will own order-form redlines (Marta replied saying she'll coordinate).
- Confirm whether marketplace listing is required for final procurement.
- Confirm target for issuing PO (we picked 7/16 as an estimate).

Action items for Redwood:
- Rachel: share SOC 2 summary + read-only link to SOC report by 2026-06-30.
- Marcus: finalize a redline-friendly order form template and be available for quick turnaround.
- Dylan/Laura: prep onboarding checklist and 3-day provisioning playbook.

I'll schedule the MPA check-in for Wed 2026-07-01 10:00 PT — feel free to propose alternatives.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@acmecloud.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 13:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan + proposed milestone dates (AcmeCloud)

Marissa / team —

Thanks for the clear plan and the MPA. We can hit the proposed timeline if Redwood provides the SOC 2 summary and a clean order form by end of day 6/30 (per your note). I've confirmed legal will review the order form by 7/7 and finance expects to issue a PO on 7/16 if there are no material redlines.

One clarification: finance prefers marketplace but will accept a PO against Redwood's order form if legal approves. We'll confirm marketplace procurement by 7/2.

I'll coordinate the legal redlines and let you know if anything blocks the timeline. Looking forward to the Wed check-in.

Regards,
Marta Ruiz
Procurement Manager, AcmeCloud
